summary: Tungray Technologies Inc, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K (the US analogue of a home-country disclosure) reporting that Chief Technology Officer Lei Yao resigned effective October 9, 2026, tendering notice September 9, 2026, with the filing dated September 11, 2026. The company states the departure is for personal reasons and not due to any disagreement over operations, policies or practices. No successor, interim appointment, severance, separation agreement, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The abrupt CTO vacancy leaves an execution gap in technology leadership; watch for a successor announcement and any subsequent 6-K on transition terms.
